name: allocation-statement
title: Departmental technology cost statement
for_each: select id,name from periods order by name

sections.title: Review status
sections.note: Draft until independently reviewed. No invoice or ledger posting is made.
sections.sql: select a.* from attention a join periods p on p.name=a.period where p.id=$1

sections.title: Allocation detail
sections.sql: select s.period,s.currency,s.service,s.unit,s.amount,s.status from showback s join periods p on p.name=s.period where p.id=$1 order by unit,service

sections.title: Budget differences
sections.sql: select v.* from budget_variance v join periods p on p.name=v.period where p.id=$1 order by unit

name: source-reconciliation
title: Source cost reconciliation
for_each: select id,source_ref as name from imports order by created_at

sections.title: Imported costs
sections.sql: select c.source_id,s.name as service,c.description,c.amount_cents,p.currency from costs c join services s on s.id=c.service_id join periods p on p.id=c.period_id where import_id=$1 order by source_id
